name: Ryoujoku Hitozuma Onsen
source:
This is a historic Japanese style hotel, but after Yuji began to work part-time, everything has gone wrong. First, the young landlady and a waitress fell victims to him. Not being satisfied with them, the next games he aims at are three young married women staying at the hotel.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6992]ANN[/url]]
translation:
这是一家历史悠久的日式旅馆，但自从裕二开始兼职后，一切都变了。首先，年轻女掌柜与女服务员成了他的受害者。他仍不满足，接下来的目标是3名下榻旅馆的年轻已婚女性。

[摘自[url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6992]ANN[/url]]
